name: Hotel Alpenfriede
beschreibung: The Hotel Alpenfriede is located in a quiet setting on the outskirts of Kitzbühel in Tirol. The accommodation offers rooms with balcony and bathroom, furnished with modern furniture. Amenities include a wellness area with sauna and steam bath, a dining room, and a private underground garage. The surroundings are characterized by hiking trails and cross-country ski trails, which are accessible directly from the hotel. In winter, guests can reach the Hahnenkamm and Kitzbühel ski areas in just a few minutes by ski bus. Guests can expect regional cuisine as part of the half-board option, which includes breakfast and dinner. The hotel is suitable for couples and families seeking a quiet stay in nature. The reception is staffed daily from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
